test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following launched the Digital Dashboard for District Ganga Committees Performance Monitoring System in April 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gajendra Singh Shekhawat.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gajendra Singh Shekhawat** launched the **Digital Dashboard for District Ganga Committees** Performance Monitoring System in **April 2022.**
 
• The Digital Dashboard is a web-based platform that provides real-time updates on the performance of the** District Ganga Committee**s in **cleaning and rejuvenating** the river Ganga.
 
• The platform will help in monitoring the** progress of the committees** and ensuring timely implementation of various projects related to the cleaning of the river.
 
• Gajendra Singh Shekhawat is the **Union Minister of Jal Shakti,** which is responsible for the **management and conservation of water resources** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nitin Jairam Gadkari** is the **Union Minister of Road Transport and Highways.**

 
 
• He has launched various** initiatives **related to infrastructure development and road safety in India.
 
 
 
• **Raj Nath Singh** is the Union Minister of **Defence**.
 
 
• He is responsible for the **defence policies and strategies** of India.
 
 
 
• **Piyush Goyal **is the Union Minister of **Commerce and Industry**.
 
 
• He is responsible for promoting** trade and commerce** in India and formulating policies related to industrial development.
